Who I am
Design is
thinking made visual
BCA Graduate · KIT Kanpur

Hi! I'm Nilesh Kumar, a UI/UX and Graphic Designer based in Banda, Uttar Pradesh. I specialise in crafting user-centred digital experiences — from wireframes and prototypes to polished high-fidelity interfaces.

Currently holding a BCA from Kanpur Institute of Technology (2022–2025), I've been honing my craft in Figma, building landing pages, web designs, and interactive prototypes that balance aesthetics with usability.

I believe great design is invisible — it simply works, feels right, and makes people's lives easier.
